long_description:
Flow through 60 minutes of Vinyasa yoga with tarot pulls woven throughout, blending movement, breath and intuitive reflection.

About this Event

What happens when you let the cards guide the practice?
Join us on the Oasis Lawn at Plaza San Antonio Hotel & Spa for Tarot Flow: Movement + Messages, a playful, intuitive 60-minute Vinyasa yoga experience blending movement, breath, and tarot.
Throughout the class, you’ll move through a flowing yoga practice with occasional tarot pulls woven into the experience. Each card becomes an invitation — a theme, question, or message to explore as you move, creating a practice that feels a little different every time.
No previous tarot experience is needed. Simply stay open to what the universe wants to say, move with intention, and see what message finds you.

Want to Go a Little Deeper?20-minute private tarot readings with Kristel will be available to book immediately following class for anyone who would like a more personalized reading.

What to BringPlease bring a yoga mat, water, and bug spray. Blocks are optional, and you’re always welcome to bring anything else that makes your practice more comfortable.

Experience Includes60-minute Vinyasa yoga flow • Tarot pulls throughout class • Guided reflection • Breathwork • Intuitive movement

LocationOasis Lawn at Plaza San Antonio Hotel & Spa
